name: EUpdate
welcome: Welcome to **EUpdate**, which brings the latest releases of GitHub repositories straight to your Falcon or TT. Find repositories and owners on GitHub, follow the ones you want into folders of your choice, see at a glance which are current, and update them with a click or on a schedule.

window.title: The window
items: The toolbar: Check, Update, Find, and how many are new.
Following: what you have, what GitHub has, current or not.
Find: repositories, or owners and theirs.
window.more: More in [[The window]], [[Where the files go]] and [[Keys]].

diagram.title: How EUpdate reaches GitHub
diagram.round: The Falcon's DSP does TLS's sums
after: EUpdate asks GitHub's API itself, over TLS on the Atari: no gateway is needed. See [[Your GitHub token]] for how often GitHub answers.
